Indian Standard (Reaffirmed 2004) 

SPECIFICATION FOR PLAIN SPOOL Jrii 
FOR TRACTOR OPERATED DISC HARROWS 



1. Scope — Specifies material, dimensions and otiier requirements for plain spool for tractor operated 
disc harrows (see IS : 6635-1972 Tractor operated disc harrows). 

2. Types 

Type A — Spools with hole for square axle. 

Type B — Spools with hole for oil bath axle assembly. ,i 

3. Material — Cast iron/ preferably conforming to Grade 20 of 13:210-1970 Grey iron castings 
[second revision ). 

4. Hardness — 1 60 to 220 HB (see IS : 1789-1961 Method for Brinell hardness test for grey cast 
iron ), 

5. Dimensions — As given in Fig. 1 and 2. 

6. Other Requirements 

6.1 Both the faces of the spool coming in contact with discs shall be finished properly to fit the 
curvature of the discs. 

6.2 The hole for axle shall be smooth and free from casting projections. 

6.3 The spools shall be free from cracks, seams and other visual defects.

RG. 2 PLAIN SPOOL (TYPE B) 

6.4 The spool shall be free from rust and shall have protective coating which will prevent surface 
deterioration in transit and storage. 

7. Marking — Each spool shall be marked clearly with the following particulars: 

a) Manufacturer's name or recognized trade-mark ( if any ), 

b) Type, and 

c) Batch or code number. 

7.1 ISI Certification l\4ark/ng— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

9. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser, the sampling 
and criteria for lot acceptance shall be done in accordance with 3 of IS; 7201-1974 ' Method of sampling 
of agricultural machinery and tractors '. The classification of different requirements of this specification 
for the purpose of sampling for lot acceptance is given below for guidance: 

a) Dimensional and visual requirements — See 5 and 6. 

b) Other than visual ^nd dimensional — See 4.
